title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting in models by adding a penalty term to the loss function. This penalty discourages overly complex models.

title: Effect of L2 Regularization
text: L2 regularization, also known as Ridge regression, adds a penalty equal to the square of the magnitude of coefficients. This tends to shrink the coefficients of less important features towards zero.

title: Variance and Regularization
text: Regularization techniques like L2 are generally used to reduce model variance, not increase it. They help in making the model more robust to new data.

title: True or False: L2 Regularization Increases Variance
text: Based on the understanding of L2 regularization, determine if the statement 'L2 regularization typically increases model variance' is true or false.
